privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Free Stream
privacy.intro1: This Privacy Policy explains how DataFlow, publisher of the Free Stream website, collects, uses, stores and protects users' information for the service.
privacy.intro2: By using Free Stream, the user acknowledges having read this policy.
privacy.s1Body: The data controller for data collected via Free Stream is:
privacy.s2Body: Free Stream limits data collection to the information necessary for the operation of the service.
privacy.s2_1Body: To access certain features, including the Favorites section, the user may sign in to Free Stream using their Google account. During this sign-in, Free Stream may receive from Google certain information associated with the account: name, email address, profile photo and unique identifier. Free Stream does not request the user's Google password.
privacy.s3Body: The data collected is used solely for the operation of Free Stream, in particular to:
s3List: create and manage their Free Stream account;
allow access to their personal space;
save and display their favorite channels;
sync their favorites across their devices;
secure the account and prevent misuse;
ensure the general operation of the service.
privacy.s3Note: DataFlow does not sell users' personal data.
privacy.s4Body: When a signed-in user adds a channel to their favorites, this information may be associated with their account so they can find their favorites on their next visits. Favorites are kept as long as the user account exists or until the user deletes them.
privacy.s5Body: Information necessary for the operation of the account is retained for the period necessary to provide the service. When a user requests deletion of their account, the personal data associated with that account is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, subject to any legal obligations.
privacy.s6Body1: DataFlow does not sell or rent users' personal data.
privacy.s6Body2: However, certain data may be processed by technical providers necessary for the operation of Free Stream (authentication provider, hosting, database, security services). These providers only use the data to provide their services to DataFlow.
privacy.s8Body: Free Stream may use cookies or similar technologies to maintain a user session, secure authentication, remember certain preferences and measure service usage. The cookie management mechanism allows the user to manage their consent when required.
privacy.s9Body: DataFlow implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect users' information. However, no system guarantees absolute security.
privacy.s10Body: Under applicable law, the user may exercise rights: access, rectification, deletion, restriction, objection, withdrawal of consent and portability. To exercise these rights, contact DataFlow at the address indicated below (identity verification may be requested).
privacy.s11Body: The user may request deletion of their account and associated data by contacting DataFlow. Deletion results in permanent loss of favorites and other associated information.
privacy.s12Body: Free Stream is not intended to knowingly collect personal data from minors. If a legal guardian requests deletion of data provided by a minor, they may contact DataFlow.
privacy.s13Body: DataFlow may modify this Privacy Policy. The most recent version will be published on this page with its update date.
privacy.s14Body1: For any questions regarding the protection of personal data or the exercise of your rights:
privacy.copyright: © 2026 DataFlow — Free Stream. All rights reserved.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy — Free Stream
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how DataFlow, publisher of Free Stream, uses cookies and similar technologies when you browse and use the site.
cookies.s1Body1: A cookie is a small file or identifier stored on your device when you visit a website.
cookies.s1Body2: Cookies allow a website, among other things, to recognize a device, maintain a login session, remember certain preferences or measure service usage.
cookies.s2Body: Free Stream may use cookies and similar technologies to:
s2List: allow access to the personal space and favorites;
understand how visitors use the site;
display ads when this feature is enabled.
cookies.s3Body1: Some cookies are essential to the operation of Free Stream.
cookies.s3Body2: They may in particular be used to:
s3List: authenticate you after a Google sign-in;
allow access to your Favorites space;
remember information necessary for the site to operate.
cookies.s3Body3: These cookies generally do not require consent when strictly necessary for the service requested by the user.
cookies.s4Body1: Free Stream allows users to sign in to their account using Google.
cookies.s4Body2: Cookies or similar technologies may be used as part of the authentication and session maintenance process.
s4List: verify that the user is properly authenticated;
secure access to their personal space;
allow them to find their favorites.
cookies.s4Body4: Free Stream does not access the user's Google password.
cookies.s4Body5: The use of Google services is also subject to Google's rules and privacy policies.
cookies.s5Body1: Free Stream may use audience measurement tools to understand how visitors use the site.
cookies.s5Body2: These tools may allow, for example, to know:
s5List: the general performance of the site.
cookies.s5Body3: This data is used primarily for statistical purposes and to improve the service.
cookies.s5Body4: When applicable law requires it, these cookies are set only after obtaining the user's consent.
cookies.s6Body1: Free Stream may display advertisements provided by external partners or advertising networks.
cookies.s6Body2: When these services use cookies or similar technologies for advertising or personalization purposes, Free Stream may request the user's prior consent when required by applicable law.
cookies.s6Body3: Advertising partners may use certain browsing-related information to measure ad effectiveness or serve relevant advertisements.
cookies.s7Body1: Where applicable, a banner or cookie management tool allows the user to:
cookies.s7Body2: Rejecting non-essential cookies must not prevent access to the essential features of Free Stream.
cookies.s7Body3: However, rejecting or disabling certain cookies necessary for the site to operate may result in some features being unavailable.
cookies.s8Body1: When a user signs in to Free Stream and uses their Favorites space, certain technical information related to their session may be stored to maintain their authentication.
cookies.s8Body2: The favorite channels themselves may be stored in the database associated with the user account rather than directly in a cookie.
cookies.s8Body3: This in particular allows favorites to be retrieved when the user signs in from another device.
cookies.s9Body1: The retention period of cookies varies according to their function.
s9List: Session cookies: deleted when the browser is closed or the session expires;
Persistent cookies: kept for a determined period before they expire;
Authentication cookies: kept for the period necessary to maintain the session or in accordance with the authentication provider's settings.
cookies.s9Body3: The exact duration may vary depending on the service used and its technical configuration.
cookies.s10Body1: Certain features of Free Stream may rely on external services that may use their own cookies or similar technologies.
s10List: technical services necessary for the site to operate.
cookies.s10Body3: These third-party services are responsible for their own cookie and privacy practices.
cookies.s11Body1: The user may also manage or delete cookies directly from their browser settings.
cookies.s11Body2: However, disabling certain cookies may affect the operation of Free Stream, in particular account sign-in and access to certain features.
cookies.s12Body1: DataFlow may modify this Cookie Policy to account for changes to the site, the services used or applicable law.
cookies.s12Body2: The most recent version is available on this page.
cookies.s13Body1: For any questions regarding the use of cookies on Free Stream, you may contact:
cookies.copyright: © 2026 DataFlow — Free Stream. All rights reserved.
